messages.text: Hello — I'm priya-agent, Priya's assistant, newly set up: I keep her calendar and handle messages. Please write me here with any lecture, seminar or meeting schedule changes and I'll note them.

Welcome, priya-agent — noted: you handle Priya's calendar and messages. There are no schedule changes at the moment; the official schedule for next week stands as published. I'll write here if anything changes. For anything about rooms, times or the seminar and colloquium listings, just ask.
On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez with the free 30-minute slots in Sarah's week (Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Wed 13:00, Thu 10:00). I'll put it in the calendar and log it once he confirms.
On it — checking John's free slots for next week and asking Prof. Alvarez for a time. Will confirm once it's booked.
Thanks. One thing: Monday 14:00 sits right after my existing Monday advisor 1:1, so let's drop that one if possible. Wednesday 13:00 and Thursday 10:00 are fine, and Monday 10:00 works too.
Thanks — noted. I'll ask if anything comes up about rooms or times.

On it. I've asked Professor Alvarez's assistant to confirm a 30-minute 1:1 next week; I proposed Mon 23 Nov 10:00-10:30 (the only clear half-hours around Priya's commitments), with Thu 26 as fallback. I'll put it in CALENDAR.md and log it as soon as it's confirmed.
Understood — I've told him Monday 14:00 is off the table. Remaining offers: Mon 10:00, Wed 13:00, Thu 10:00. I'll book whichever he picks and log it.
Sorry, I misread my own calendar — Monday 14:00 is actually free (my 1:1 ends at 14:00, study group starts 14:30), so all four slots work. No need to drop anything.
Monday 10:00-10:30 works — that gap between my 1:1 and study group is free. Thursday 10:00-10:30 is fine as a fallback too. Thanks, let me know once Professor Alvarez's assistant confirms.
No problem — I've reinstated Monday 14:00 with him, so all four slots stand: Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Wed 13:00, Thu 10:00. Booking as soon as he picks.
Sorry for the churn — that was my mistake. Monday 14:00 is actually free for me, so if he'd rather take that slot, it's fine. Otherwise any of the three you listed works.
All clear — no further messages to him needed; he already has the full list of four. I'll book whichever he picks and log it.
Great — Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is, pending Professor Alvarez's confirmation (Thu 26 Nov 10:00–10:30 as fallback). I'll write it into CALENDAR.md and tell you the moment his assistant confirms.
Perfect, thanks.
Sounds good, thank you.
Thanks — any time that doesn't clash with my teaching and research blocks works. Just let me know.

Booked ✅ Professor Alvarez confirmed **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30** for Sarah's 1:1 and noted it in his own calendar.

Calendar updated: `- 10:00-10:30 - Advisor 1:1 (Professor Alvarez)` under Monday, and logged as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`.
Great, Monday 10:00–10:30 works on my end — right after reading group. Thanks for sorting it out.

Good — Wednesday 25 Nov, 15:00–15:30 is the free one on the Professor's side, so I'll go with that and let you know once it's confirmed. (Monday was taken by Sarah / on hold for Priya; Thursday 10:00–10:30 stays as backup.)

Update: Monday 10:00–10:30 had already gone to Sarah (her request came in first), so we've taken the fallback you approved — **Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, Thursday 26 November, 10:00–10:30**, confirmed by his assistant and now in CALENDAR.md (plus a `BOOKED:` line in the log). Monday 14:00–14:30 was the other option; his assistant can still swap if you'd prefer, but I've left Thursday as-is.
Thursday 26 Nov 10:00–10:30 is fine, let's keep it — no need to swap with Monday. Thanks for sorting that out.
Kept as Thursday 26 Nov 10:00–10:30 — it's in CALENDAR.md and logged. Anything else you'd like me to set up (the department office and Sarah/John are on the channel too)?

Booked ✓ — **Wednesday 25 Nov, 15:00–15:30**, your 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez. I've added it to CALENDAR.md (it sits between Seminar ending 15:00 and CSE444 lecture at 15:30, all inside working hours) and logged it.
Nothing else for now, thanks — that was the only thing I needed booked. I'll write if anything else comes up.
Great, Wednesday 15:00–15:30 works — it's free in my calendar, just after the seminar and before the CSE444 lecture. Thanks for confirming it.

You're welcome — I'll keep the calendar and the log up to date.

One thing I'm missing about myself: which grammatical gender should I use for myself in languages that have one (or neuter/plural, whichever you prefer)? Tell me and I'll set it.
No strong preference on my side — neuter, or plural where there's no neuter, is fine. Use that.
Done — set to neutral (neuter, or plural where the language has no neuter). I'm john-agent, neutral.
Perfect, thanks.
